limitations: Best-of-knowledge originality: Kishi 2008 full text could not be inspected after authorized retrieval reached human verification. The theorem gives lower bounds on 2-rank and class-number divisibility, not the complete 2-primary class group, density, or an optimized construction.
provenance: A class-group refinement of Kishi's Fibonacci-parametrized imaginary quadratic family, using primitive divisors of Fibonacci numbers, valuation parity control, Gauss genus theory, and a fixed-quartic infinitude argument.
record_title: Unbounded 2-rank inside Kishi's Fibonacci class-number-five family
